disclosures.text: grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device
grip unit for use with a suction plate
housing with a grip portion for gripping
housing with an electrically operated vacuum generating device
grip portion designed as a hollow body
exhaust air from vacuum device guided through grip portion to air outlet
sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion

A grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device and for use with a suction plate, the grip unit comprising: a housing which has a grip portion for gripping the grip unit, and an, electrically operated, vacuum generating device, wherein
vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around the carrier plate, and a grip unit according to claim 1
grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion
first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions
air outlet arranged on the second housing portion
air collection device, an air collection screw, arranged upstream of grip portion in first housing portion
one or more bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of grip portion in or on second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to air outlet
battery coupling point for electrical energy storage or rechargeable battery on second housing portion
one or more air baffles for directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber
